name: helios-type-69-clean-air-tighten
description: CLEAN, transparent corrective EQ from the UADx Helios Type 69 — the LINE-mode (no-drive) counterpart to the warm-drum-glue preset. Line input at gain 20 keeps the preamp essentially clean (measured 0.002% THD), so this is pure passive-style EQ: +4 dB of the broad 10 kHz Helios air shelf, a -3 dB bass low-shelf to TIGHTEN/control the bottom, and a 700 Hz MID TROUGH (the Peak/Trough switch in cut mode) at mid_gain 12 to de-box the low-mids. Because nothing saturates, crest goes UP (14.6 -> 16.2 dB) — the tell of a clean EQ move vs the glue preset's crest drop. Measured on the Watercolors drum loop: -2.9 dB @50 (tighter), -4 dB @500 (de-boxed), +3.5 dB @10k (air).
intended_for: a drum bus / loop / source that needs a smooth musical EQ — air on top, a tighter low end, low-mid box removed — WITHOUT any console colour. Use the warm-drum-glue preset instead when you want preamp saturation/glue.
plugin_build: UADx 'uaudio_helios_type_69.vst3' (UADx native build, renders headless via Pedalboard 0.9.23 — not the 'UAD …'/Legacy .component twins). 14 enum params; string enums (input_select/mid_type/eq_in) need this setattr harness, not apply-vst-chain's float dict.
notes: PEAK/TROUGH IS NONLINEAR — the #1 footgun. In Peak (boost) mode mid_gain is 1:1 (8 -> +8.2 dB). In Trough (cut) mode the SAME knob remaps far smaller: mid_gain 8 -> a true ~-2.1 (only ~-1.3 dB cut); you must push toward 12-15 for a real cut (12 -> -4.1 @500, 15 -> -5.3). ALWAYS set mid_type FIRST, then read back mid_gain (getattr) to see the TRUE applied value. This preset uses Trough + 12 for ~-4 dB of de-box.

THE 10 kHz SHELF IS BROAD. hi_shelf_gain +4 is measured as a wide high shelf that begins lifting from ~1-2 kHz (+1 @1k) and reaches ~+4-5 by 10k and above — gentle 'air + presence', not a narrow peak. It's asymmetric: boosts only to +12 but cuts to -16 (use -4..-16 to gently darken).

BASS HERE = TIGHTEN ONLY. bass -3 is a broad low shelf (-2.6 @50, -1.5 @80) that controls/tightens the bottom. Remember the bass BOOST positions (60/120/250/400) are inert headless, so this knob can only cut — for low-end weight use the Mic-drive (warm) preset or `[L] apply-eq`.

CLEAN TELL: because Line g20 doesn't saturate, this move RAISES crest (14.6 -> 16.2) and barely adds harmonics — the opposite of the warm-drum-glue preset. If your measured crest DROPS, you accidentally drove the preamp (check input_select=Line, gain=20, pad=Off).
Verify with measure-spectrum: expect ~-3 @50, ~-4 @500, +3-4 toward 10k; a 0.00 delta means the passthrough .component twin loaded — confirm the path is the uaudio_ build.
